source.title: Clearing Procedures
source.applicability: Procedures 1-3 concern Binance RCH clearing/settlement and incorporate separate Clearing Rules. This document alone does not establish this repository account's jurisdiction, product eligibility or current effective rules.

source_claims.fact: Maintenance uses position value times rate minus maintenance amount; tiers are separately published and amendable.
source_claims.effect: The previous simple proportional scenario is not a complete exchange maintenance calculation.

source_claims.fact: Funding uses position value times adjusted rate; positive funding pays shorts. Payments enter settlement-asset balances and debits may reduce position margin. COIN-M position value is reciprocal in mark price.
source_claims.effect: Coin cash flows and each settlement mark belong in an integrated hedge ledger; rates and schedules are not immutable.

source_claims.fact: The other-position UPNL definition uses side times the reciprocal entry-minus-mark difference; side is positive for long and negative for short.
The COIN-M PnL equation instead uses reciprocal mark-minus-entry and again labels long positive and short negative.
source_claims.effect: Internal sign conflict; do not silently repair source semantics or promote a venue-specific model.

source_claims.fact: Delivery settlement uses the every-second index arithmetic average over the preceding 30 minutes. Settlement can be delayed; new positions may be restricted before expiry; settlement fees apply.
source_claims.effect: An instantaneous executable spot exit is not the stated settlement average. Source currentness and exact contract applicability remain unproved.

source_claims.fact: Default close-out need not achieve the best price. Settlement reversals can occur without exact restoration; realized PnL changes margin balances.
source_claims.effect: Algebraic hedging is not an unconditional custody, execution or finality guarantee.

source_claims.fact: The procedures can be amended and incorporate separate rules and terms. The document states no historical versions are currently available.
source_claims.effect: Access date and content hash identify this retained version but do not establish its effective date.

retained_inventory.scope: All nine BTC/ETH/SOL rows: perpetual, September 25 and December 25 contracts. Metadata only; no funding or price values accessed.
retained_inventory.implication: Use actual contract units and separate USD quote from executable stablecoin conversion. No new instrument request is justified by this retained metadata alone.

decision.next_action: Reuse this exact document offline. Require an independently evidenced official correction or authoritative reconciliation of the opposite signs, plus effective-version and contract-unit mapping, before using it to qualify a Binance inverse model. Continue other eligible economic work; do not refetch the PDF or FAQ aliases.
